fragment NaryConnectorDeclaration returns SysML::Connector :
	FeatureDeclaration? 
	'(' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember ',' 
	    ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember
	    ( ',' ownedRelationship += ConnectorEndMember )* 
	')'
;

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in NaryConnectorDeclaration@kerml
